title: Образ для роли и неожиданный кофе  (In Character and an Unexpected Coffee)

segments.t: Still dressed in his eccentric rehearsal look, Nagiyev explains that he is staying in character so people can see his artistic range. When a waitress brings him a cup of coffee he never asked for, he realizes someone at another table sent it over and preens with pride.
Right, let's take their exchange slowly and unpack the Russian.
